oneLiner: Instantly re-orient when you switch projects—see the last decision, open blockers, and who's waiting on you.
problem: PMs juggling multiple projects lose critical context every time they switch, spending the first 10-15 minutes reconstructing what happened last, who's blocked, and who's owed a response—often missing something important in the process.
targetUser: Product managers and leads simultaneously running 3+ active projects who context-switch multiple times a day
coreFlow: PM lands on a home view listing all active projects with last-touched time and status glance
PM selects a project they're re-entering
Regroup surfaces a re-entry summary: the last decision made, its rationale, and date
PM reviews current blockers and a 'waiting on you / you're waiting on' list with names and ages
PM takes quick action—reply, reassign, snooze, or mark resolved—directly from the summary
PM switches to the next project and the cycle repeats

screens.name: Project Switcher
screens.purpose: Give a bird's-eye view of all projects with last activity and health status for quick navigation

screens.name: Re-entry Summary
screens.purpose: Core screen showing the last decision, its context, and immediate blockers so a PM can regain footing in seconds

screens.name: Waiting-On Board
screens.purpose: List everyone waiting on the PM and everyone the PM is waiting on, with age and priority

screens.name: Decision Log
screens.purpose: Chronological history of key decisions per project for deeper context or audit

screens.name: Integrations Settings
screens.purpose: Connect Slack, Jira, or email so decisions and blockers can be logged with minimal manual entry

outOfScope: Full task/project management (replacing Jira, Asana, etc.)
Automated AI extraction of decisions from chat/email (v1)
